results.name: tree_insert_unique
results.evidence: Walks a binary tree from the head's parent using a byte-wise lexicographic key compare (inlined std::string::compare loop) to find the insertion point, checks node[0x2d] as an 'is nil/sentinel' flag, then on non-duplicate calls FUN_0057ce10 (compare) and FUN_0057c390 to allocate/link a new node, returning an iterator+bool pair; matches MSVC71 std::_Tree::insert(value) for a map/set keyed by string.

results.name: tree_erase_range
results.evidence: Special-cases erasing the whole tree (param_2==begin && param_3==head) by calling FUN_0057cce0 (recursive subtree destroy) and relinking the head node, otherwise loops advancing an iterator via FUN_0057c5e0 (tree increment) and erasing each node via FUN_0057c820.
results.summary: Erases a [first,last) range of nodes from a red-black tree, taking a fast path that destroys the whole tree when the range spans it entirely.

results.name: tree_lower_bound
results.evidence: Descends the tree from the head's parent using the same inlined lexicographic string-compare loop as FUN_0057c1a0/FUN_0057ce10, tracking the last node not less than the key and returning it; matches std::_Tree::lower_bound / find style traversal.
results.summary: Finds the tree node whose key is the lower bound for the key referenced by in_ECX, returning that node (or the head sentinel if none).

results.name: tree_iterator_increment
results.evidence: Exactly the canonical MSVC STL _Tree::_Inc algorithm: if the right child is not the nil sentinel (byte at +0x2d), descend to its leftmost node; otherwise climb parents while the current node is a right child.
results.summary: Advances a red-black tree iterator (passed via EDX) to the next node in sorted order.

results.name: string_pair_construct_empty

results.name: string_grow_reserve

results.name: catch_string_grow_alloc

results.name: string_copy_into_new_buffer

results.name: catch_string_grow_cleanup_rethrow

results.name: tree_rotate_left
results.evidence: Matches the canonical MSVC STL _Tree::_Lrotate red-black rotation: takes the right child, relinks its left subtree as the node's right child, fixes the parent pointer of the moved subtree, and re-links parent/child pointers on both sides.
results.summary: Performs a left rotation on a red-black tree node (in_ECX) about its right child, relinking parent/child pointers.

results.name: tree_find_min

results.name: tree_rotate_right
results.evidence: Mirror image of FUN_0057cb10: takes the left child, relinks its right subtree as the node's left child, and fixes up parent/child pointers; matches MSVC STL _Tree::_Rrotate.
results.summary: Performs a right rotation on a red-black tree node (in_ECX) about its left child, relinking parent/child pointers.

results.name: tree_find_max

results.name: tree_iterator_decrement
